catalogue.name: Confession Box
catalogue.description: Assumes +2 piety when assessing the start player.

catalogue.name: Chapel
catalogue.description: Generates +1 piety when Clerical Duty and Devotion is selected.

catalogue.name: Chapter House
catalogue.description: May add a 2nd acolyte to a single special activity (via Allocation) for an additional +1 bonus. Maximum 2/ Activity.

catalogue.name: Guild
catalogue.description: May move the Merchant clockwise +1 Duty tile.

catalogue.name: Infirmary
catalogue.description: Gives a +1 to Allocation and Ordination Duties ({wheat} required for Ordination).

catalogue.name: Mint
catalogue.description: Generates +1 {silver} when Clerical Duty and Silversmith is selected.

catalogue.name: Quarry
catalogue.description: Generates +1 {stone} when Produce (stone) Duty is selected.

catalogue.name: Well
catalogue.description: Generates +1 {wheat} when Produce (wheat) Duty is selected.

catalogue.name: Brewery
catalogue.description: A single {wheat} may be sold for 2 {silver}.

catalogue.name: Cloisters
catalogue.description: When moving acolytes to Duty actions, a player may skip one Duty tile or the city.

catalogue.name: Dormitory
catalogue.description: At the start of a player's turn an acolyte may be returned from any Duty action to the City.

catalogue.name: Grain Store
catalogue.description: Buy or sell one or more {wheat} for 1 {silver} each.

catalogue.name: Indulgences
catalogue.description: Buy or sell one or more piety for 1 {silver} each.

catalogue.name: Library
catalogue.description: At the end of a player's turn move 1 acolyte from the city directly to a Duty action or back to the abbey.

catalogue.name: Reliquary
catalogue.description: -1 piety point discount when building a Shrine or on Pilgrimage Site costs.

catalogue.name: Stone Yard
catalogue.description: Buy or sell one or more {stone} for 1 {silver} each.

catalogue.name: Bank
catalogue.description: {silver} can be used instead of any single resource (including Piety) for one transaction.

catalogue.name: Customs House
catalogue.description: When taking the Taxation Duty a majority is claimed on any Duty the active player's acolytes occupy, including the Taxation Duty.

catalogue.name: Inquisition
catalogue.description: At the start of their turn, a player may move one of their acolytes from the city to any Duty.

catalogue.name: Kogge
catalogue.description: Acolytes may now move against the flow of the map board rivers to enter or leave the City.

catalogue.name: Mill
catalogue.description: Alms and Ordination Duties do not expend {wheat} if the player holds up to 2 {wheat}. A 3rd {wheat} must be held and spent if a 3rd action is taken.

catalogue.name: Pulpit
catalogue.description: Ordain one serf from the village and move them to the abbey with no {wheat} cost. The Infirmary bonus may not be applied.

catalogue.name: Scriptorium
catalogue.description: On the player's turn, add +1 to the acolyte total on all Duty tiles that player occupies.

catalogue.name: Wagon Yard
catalogue.description: Hire any live building for no fee. This may be used by the owning player when the Merchant is visiting the Taxation Duty.
